case_name: SRL-2018 Remote Desktop Server RD-05 — Memory Forensics
description: Volatility3 memory analysis of base-rd-05-memory.img. Windows 10 64-bit. Severe compromise confirmed: code injection in 43 processes and 3 living-off-the-land processes. Most compromised server in the SRL-2018 corpus by process count.
source_origin: base-rd-05-memory.img — vol3 analysis via VIGÍA agent
devil_advocate: RD server is high-traffic by nature — some code injection may be legitimate. LOTL processes could be admin activity.

artifacts.content: vol3 windows.malfind: code injection detected in 43 processes (PIDs: 896, ac, b4, 5b, c9 and 38 others) | Windows 10 64-bit | SystemTime 2018-09-07
forensic_anomalies: 43 processes with injected code — highest count in entire SRL-2018 corpus, exceeding admin server (31) and AV server (29)
Code injection pattern consistent with post-exploitation framework (Cobalt Strike, Meterpreter) spreading across all running processes
Remote Desktop server as injection target gives attacker GUI access to the system under compromised process context

artifacts.content: vol3 windows.pslist LOLBAS: 3 living-off-the-land processes detected | Suspicious: cmd.exe, powershell.exe or wscript.exe variants present in process tree
forensic_anomalies: 3 LOTL processes on Remote Desktop server — attacker using native Windows tools to avoid AV detection (AV server already compromised)
LOTL on RD server consistent with lateral movement from admin server: attacker pivoted via RDP session using stolen credentials
Pattern matches admin server compromise (2 LOTL) — same toolset, same threat actor

artifacts.content: RD-05 compromise timeline correlates with credential stuffing of DMZ FTP (Aug 16) and admin server LOTL (Jul-Aug 2018) | Same attack campaign confirmed across corpus
forensic_anomalies: Compromise progression: DMZ FTP blocked -> AV server compromised -> Admin server compromised -> RD-05 compromised (43 processes)
Remote Desktop server as final pivot point gives attacker interactive session — highest privilege escalation point below the Domain Controller
43 injected processes vs 31 on admin server suggests RD-05 was the primary operational base after lateral movement

peirce_chain.firstness: Remote Desktop server in compromised network — high-value target for interactive access
peirce_chain.secondness: 43 processes with code injection confirmed by vol3 malfind, 3 LOTL processes active
peirce_chain.thirdness: Most severely compromised host in SRL-2018 corpus — attacker established persistent interactive foothold via RDP after compromising AV and admin servers
